mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the front side was the clearest physical change: a dark green panel appeared along the near edge.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the back fin was less rewarding in text because the new fin was hard to distinguish from the existing reddish pieces.

surprise.text: The tail was described as reddish panels extending at the sides, so its placement was less clear than I expected.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though both flips were prescribed orientation changes rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would probably not continue: the instructions were clear, but the forced sequence and subtle text descriptions made the completed whale less rewarding for me. Text alone cannot establish how clear the artwork is.
